purpose: Stage 4 CPU-only offline replay, parser/resource repair, static allocation audit, and protected archive verification

Compute.name: compute_mapping_check
Compute.description: Summarize archived program and callable mappings without unverified Candidate source attribution. Returns details with total_records, returned_records, records, and next_cursor (null on the last page).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by this tool.

limit.description: Maximum detail records to return; defaults to 20.

Compute.name: compute_unit_activity
Compute.description: Aggregate all PMU counters by archived build, rank, dispatch, and core type. Returns details with total_records, returned_records, records, and next_cursor (null on the last page).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by this tool.

limit.description: Maximum detail records to return; defaults to 20.

Compute.name: compute_task_share
Compute.description: Aggregate PMU counters by task only after same-dispatch task and callable joins validate. Returns details with total_records, returned_records, records, and next_cursor (null on the last page).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by this tool.

limit.description: Maximum detail records to return; defaults to 20.

Dataflow.name: tile_access_check
Dataflow.description: Summarize all archived compiler hint categories and preserve their original text. Returns details with total_records, returned_records, records, and next_cursor (null on the last page).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by this tool.

limit.description: Maximum detail records to return; defaults to 20.

Dataflow.name: buffer_pressure_check
Dataflow.description: Summarize MemoryReuse hints and Scope fields without inferring capacity pressure. Returns details with total_records, returned_records, records, and next_cursor (null on the last page).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by this tool.

limit.description: Maximum detail records to return; defaults to 20.

Dataflow.name: tile_memory_allocation_summary
Dataflow.description: Summarize verified static allocation requests by artifact, function, memory space, and operation without inferring runtime pressure.

Schedule.name: dependency_path_check
Schedule.description: Summarize normalized dependency graph structure without runtime weights. Returns details with total_records, returned_records, records, and next_cursor (null on the last page).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by this tool.

limit.description: Maximum detail records to return; defaults to 20.

Schedule.name: dispatch_gap_check
Schedule.description: Summarize same-core AICore interval gaps in cycles; these gaps are not attributed to scheduling. Returns details with total_records, returned_records, records, and next_cursor (null on the last page).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by this tool.

limit.description: Maximum detail records to return; defaults to 20.

Schedule.name: task_distribution_check
Schedule.description: Summarize AICore interval durations per core, tuple counts, and distinct raw task tokens without inferring busy time or load balance. Returns details with total_records, returned_records, records, and next_cursor (null on the last page).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by this tool.

limit.description: Maximum detail records to return; defaults to 20.

limitations: Sizes are explicit compile-time allocation requests in bytes; HCCL window-buffer sizes are per rank.

limitations: Sizes are explicit compile-time allocation requests in bytes; HCCL window-buffer sizes are per rank.

observations.name: dependency_task_metadata_count
observations.aggregation: count valid task metadata records

observations.name: dependency_node_count
observations.aggregation: union task metadata IDs and valid edge endpoints

observations.name: dependency_edge_record_count
observations.aggregation: count valid edge records before duplicate removal

observations.name: dependency_unique_edge_count
observations.aggregation: count unique directed predecessor/successor pairs

observations.name: dependency_duplicate_edge_record_count
observations.aggregation: valid edge records minus unique directed pairs

observations.name: dependency_endpoint_without_task_metadata_count
observations.aggregation: count edge endpoints absent from task metadata

observations.name: dependency_weak_component_count
observations.aggregation: count connected components after treating each directed edge as undirected

observations.name: dependency_maximum_fan_in
observations.aggregation: maximum unique incoming neighbors for any graph node

observations.name: dependency_maximum_fan_out
observations.aggregation: maximum unique outgoing neighbors for any graph node

observations.name: dependency_graph_edge_path_depth
observations.aggregation: maximum number of edges in an unweighted directed acyclic path

limitations: Graph measurements describe the indexed dependency structure only; no runtime weights or latency are attached.
Duplicate edge records are counted separately from unique task-to-task edges, and endpoints absent from task metadata remain explicit.

observations.name: raw_swimlane_record_count
observations.aggregation: count rows in named swimlane arrays without interpreting tuple positions

observations.name: aicore_observed_gap_cycles
observations.aggregation: for each core, sort valid AICore intervals by start cycle and summarize positive next.start - previous.end gaps

observations.name: merged_trace_event_count
observations.aggregation: count archived traceEvents without assuming they match raw tuple rows

limitations: Observed AICore interval gaps are not attributed to scheduling: producer readiness, dispatch, pickup, core occupancy, and scheduler phase evidence are not joined here.
Raw and merged swimlane coverage are reported separately; their rows are not assumed to have equal or uniquely joined task/block coverage.
Intervals are compared only within one indexed artifact's rank/dispatch/core scope; gaps are in recorded clock cycles.
